description: Atlas do Saneamento is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). As profundas desigualdades regionais existentes na infra-estrutura de saneamento fazem da universalização e da melhoria dos serviços de abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, limpeza urbana, coleta de lixo e drenagem urbana, um objetivo a ser alcançado, ainda hoje, pelo Estado e conquistado pela sociedade brasileira. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Saneamento, Esgoto Sanitário, Lixo, Abastecimento de Água, Bacias Hidrográficas. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
